title: ProgramIR manifest (ratified shape)
description: The RATIFIED manifest shape: spec/manifest.md components table + the D-029 rulings, spec/versions.md (PIR-001), spec/placement.md placement blocks, spec/invariants.md discipline laws. This schema validates the post-ratification form, NOT the pre-ratification example artifacts (which fail by design -- see schema/README.md for the counterexample audit and the migrator's checklist). Feature subset is deliberately restricted so a stdlib-only hand-rolled validator can implement it exactly; see schema/README.md.

versions.description: REQUIRED versions block, spec/versions.md + PIR-001. Written at save; the first thing `explain` prints. An absent block is PIR-E-MANIFEST-* malformed -- no unversioned grandfathering.

components.description: The numbered component map, spec/manifest.md components table. Keys keep the examples' numbered form; 8a/8b are conceptual rows only and never appear as keys (spec/manifest.md D-029 ruling 1).

provenance.description: Optional artifact-level provenance {source, date, evidence, ...} -- AUTHORITY.md evidence discipline and PIR-014 (machine-written mutation chains). Shape intentionally loose until ratified.

version_string.description: A version entry. The string grammar (MAJOR.MINOR vs full semver) is explicitly NOT ratified -- spec/versions.md open item 0 -- so this schema requires only a non-empty string. Same-major accepts; otherwise refuse with PIR-E-VERSION-* naming the entry and both versions.

versions_block.description: The ratified versions block, spec/versions.md (D-024) + PIR-001: ir_version plus every closed vocabulary and consumed contract. All seven entries are required; a missing required entry is PIR-E-MANIFEST-* malformed.

node_set.description: The forward node-set grammar version, spec/versions.md + spec/node-set.md SEM-8 (v0 is the observed encoding of examples 13-15). Whether it rides ir_version is open item 2 -- the entry itself is required either way.

roles.description: The semantic_role closed vocabulary version, spec/versions.md; the vocabulary itself is in $defs/semantic_role.

strategies.description: The adapter-ir strategy vocabulary version in force, spec/versions.md.

codecs.description: The adapter-ir codec vocabulary version in force, spec/versions.md.

adapter_ir.description: The consumed adapter-ir contract version, spec/versions.md; exact-vs-range pinning is open item 1.

lm15.description: The consumed lm15 wire-contract version, spec/versions.md; exact-vs-range pinning is open item 1.

additionalProperties.description: Additional entries are permitted as version strings: extending a vocabulary is a versioned act recorded in changes/ and reflected in the block (spec/versions.md). How a reader treats an entry it does not implement is not yet ratified -- recorded in schema/README.md.

identifier.description: A simple name: variable, field, or predictor segment. The node set's assignment targets are simple names only (spec/node-set.md SEM-5 ruling).

predictor_path.description: A dotted predictor/module path keying the per-predictor maps (components 2/3a/3b/3c) and 5_forward -- e.g. 'self', 'gen', 'drafter.classifier.classify'. spec/manifest.md shape rules: per-predictor learned state is keyed by predictor path.

pool_name.description: A pool-entry name (adapter/LM/tool/interpreter/metric pools). Identity-bearing shareable components are named pools; the tree carries bindings by name (PIR-009). Deterministic base normalization and -2/-3 collision suffixing are specified in spec/manifest.md.

language_tag.description: A declared language tag, e.g. 'python' -- PIR-012: every packaged and authored code entry carries `language`; the artifact carries one env block per language present (D-025). No closed vocabulary is ratified yet.

json_schema.description: An embedded JSON Schema value (draft 2020-12 admits boolean schemas). Used for signature field `shape` and tool `return_schema`. Contents are not meta-validated here.

placement.description: The per-component placement block, spec/placement.md. The contract never moves; only rung/endpoint/isolation/credential do. Identity deviations detach scores; placement changes do not (PIR-010).

rung.description: The ladder rung, spec/placement.md. Observed values: 'in_process', 'http_local', 'http_remote'. The rung vocabulary is not ratified as closed, so any non-empty string is accepted here.

contract.description: The typed interface, identical across rungs, spec/placement.md. The spec sketch shows an object; the reference artifacts carry a string signature (e.g. 'forward(LMRequest)->LMResponse'); both are accepted until the form is ratified.

endpoint_ref.description: Name of the receiver-bound endpoint binding (an env-var-like reference the receiver resolves), spec/placement.md. Null/absent for in-process placements. The declared-tier profile requires endpoint rungs to bind through this (D-023).

default_endpoint.description: Advisory default URL for endpoint_ref, spec/placement.md placement block.

isolation.description: The receiver's isolation envelope, spec/placement.md isolation gradient (D-042, ratified 2026-08-12): the ordered closed vocabulary v1.0, comparable by position (PIR-015). Artifacts using the gradient stamp versions.isolation = '1.0' (spec/versions.md). Null reads as unset (receiver default).

isolation_floor.description: Optional baked minimum isolation demand on this placement (D-042; PIR-015): the receiver's envelope may exceed the floor, never under-run it -- under-floor is a loud load refusal (PIR-E-VERIFY-004). Mirrors the interpreter structural profile's required isolation_floor.

floor_lowered_by.description: Provenance of a floor-lowering edit (D-042; PIR-017): lowering a floor is an artifact edit producing a new artifact version, never an engine flag. Absent when the floor was never lowered.

credential_ref.description: Name of a declared credential (component 10 entry) this placement authenticates with, spec/placement.md + PIR-005 (names, never values).

isolation_level.description: The ordered isolation vocabulary v1.0 (D-042, spec/placement.md): none < namespace < fork < fork_cgroup < fork_ratchet < sandbox < remote. Ordering is normative -- 'floor' is defined by position comparison (PIR-015). Closed; extension is a versioned act (versions.isolation).

floor_provenance.description: The floor-lowering provenance record (D-042 point 7; PIR-017): who lowered the floor, when, from what to what. Rides the placement block of the edited entry.

by.description: Who signed for the lowered floor (PIR-014 provenance discipline).

new.description: The floor after the edit (strictly lower than old -- raising needs no edit; it is a binding).

grant.description: One entry of the closed static effect row (D-043 unified leaf substrate; PIR-021): a capability the parent explicitly hands the leaf. Grants are orthogonal to the isolation level -- every envelope must supply every declared grant or load refuses (PIR-E-VERIFY-005; PIR-018).

kind.description: Closed grant kind: 'fd' -- a passed/inherited file descriptor (sealed-memfd data plane, listening sockets); 'broker_route' -- a hostname route through the parent-owned broker proxy (D-043: credential injection, per-request log); 'leaf' -- a pool leaf the granted (session) leaf may call back into through the engine bridge (the PIR-021 grant-bridge byte shape; contract-sync wave 2026-08-12).

name.description: The grant's name: the FD's declared role, the broker route's hostname pattern, or the granted pool leaf's name ('leaf' kind).

code_identity.description: A declared code identity for packaged/authored entries (PIR-003 declare-don't-discover; PIR-014 provenance). Used by LM entries' `class`.

identity.description: Import-path-like identity of the class/function, spec/manifest.md components 6/8a (identity is baked; PIR-003).

origin.description: Where the code comes from: 'packaged' (shipped with a named library) or 'authored' (source baked into the artifact). PIR-012/D-025; adapter-layer authored code never rung-walks (D-026).

language.description: REQUIRED declared language -- PIR-012: every packaged and authored code entry carries `language`.

source.description: Artifact-relative path to the baked source (required when origin='authored'), spec/manifest.md on-disk layout: binary/code sidecars never inline (PIR-004).

deps.description: Declared dependency names, spec/manifest.md components 6/8a + PIR-003.

authored_by.description: PIR-014: machine-written or machine-mutated code carries authored_by into the artifact.

mutations.description: PIR-014: the mutation chain of machine-mutated code. Entry shape not yet ratified; loose.

semantic_role.description: The closed semantic-role vocabulary from the adapter-ir contract (dspy roadmap epic C; IR-program-spec section b component 2): what the field means to the exchange -- intent, hence frozen. Versioned by versions.roles; extension requires the admission rule ('must change how the exchange is conducted', spec/versions.md).

signature_field.description: One signature field, spec/manifest.md component 2: {name, direction, prefix, desc, shape, semantic_role}. This is the RATIFIED shape -- the examples' {role, description, annotation} keys are pre-ratification and fail here (migrator renames; see schema/README.md).

name.description: The semantic field name (Prediction key), spec/manifest.md component 2; PIR-013: Prediction fields = declared output fields, no more, no less.

direction.description: Input/output designation -- the renamed old `role` key (IR-program-spec section b component 2; adapter-ir SignatureCore).

prefix.description: Rendering prefix, nullable (adapter-ir SignatureCore: prefix: str | null).

desc.description: Field description, nullable (adapter-ir SignatureCore: desc: str | null). The canonical key is 'desc'; 'description' is not an alias (spec/manifest.md, ratified 2026-08-07).

shape.description: The field's data type as JSON Schema -- arbitrary, no blessed type list; hints with no JSON-schema meaning refuse loudly at lowering (IR-program-spec section b component 2; adapter-ir ADP-010).

semantic_role.description: The field's relationship to the exchange, spec/manifest.md component 2. Intent, frozen; the strategy answering it is component-4 mechanism.

signature.description: A per-predictor signature, spec/manifest.md component 2: ordered fields[]. Instructions are NOT stored here -- they live once in 3a (IR-program-spec section b: component 2 does not duplicate them). The examples duplicate instructions into component 2; that pre-ratification form fails here.

demo.description: One demo or devset example: a flat record whose non-reserved keys are field values and whose required input_keys[] carries the input/label designation. 'input_keys' is reserved metadata; frontend lowering refuses a signature field with that name (spec/manifest.md, ratified 2026-08-07).

input_keys.description: Which of this demo's fields are inputs (the rest are labels), spec/manifest.md component 3b.

bindings.description: A Predict leaf's pool bindings, spec/manifest.md shape rules (pools + tree bindings) + component 1: leaves bind {adapter, lm, delta} by name. Every name must resolve to a declared pool entry at link or load refuses (PIR-009, PIR-E-LINK-*).

adapter.description: Names a component-4 adapter pool entry, spec/manifest.md component 1 + spec/linking.md step 4.

lm.description: Names a component-8 LM pool entry, spec/manifest.md component 1 + spec/linking.md step 4.

delta.description: Optional weights-delta name: effective weights are the LM entry's base (+) this delta, each carrying its own frozen/weight-ref tag (spec/manifest.md shape rules, base-plus-delta). Null when no delta. Where delta entries live (a pool of their own vs nested under the LM entry) is NOT yet ratified -- recorded in schema/README.md; a delta name that resolves nowhere is PIR-E-LINK-002.

tree_node.description: A module-tree node, spec/manifest.md component 1. Discriminated on kind: 'Predict' nodes are binding-carrying leaves; every other kind is a module node with a forward.

predict_leaf.description: A Predict leaf, spec/manifest.md component 1: carries bindings {adapter, lm, delta}; never has children. A root-level bare-Predict program is this node at the root with the trivial forward under 5_forward/'self'.

name.description: The leaf's attribute name; the root is conventionally 'self'.

children.description: Always empty on a Predict leaf, spec/manifest.md component 1.

bindings.description: The leaf's pool bindings, spec/manifest.md component 1 + PIR-009.

forward_ref.description: Optional pointer to this predictor's trivial forward (root bare-Predict programs), keyed into component 5.

module_node.description: A composite module node, spec/manifest.md component 1: names its forward in component 5 and carries children (Predict leaves and sub-modules).

kind.description: The module class name (never 'Predict' -- that form is the leaf), spec/manifest.md component 1.

name.description: The node's attribute name in its parent; the root is conventionally 'self'.

module_class.description: Optional duplicate of the authored class name (observability; matches kind in the reference artifacts).

forward_ref.description: Pointer to this module's forward under component 5, spec/manifest.md component 5 (per-module node-set JSON).

uses_interpreter.description: Optional declaration hint that this module's forward contains interpreter leaves (PIR-003 declare-don't-discover); the authoritative reference is each leaf's ref (D-029).

tools.description: Optional declaration of the component-6 tool names this module's forward may dispatch to (the model-dispatched call convention, spec/node-set.md leaf rule; PIR-003).

children.description: Child nodes: Predict leaves and sub-modules, spec/manifest.md component 1.

forward_stub.description: A per-module forward, spec/manifest.md component 5. This schema pins only the envelope; the statement grammar is schema/node-set.schema.json (spec/node-set.md SEM-8), applied by the node_compile op -- kept out of this file so neither schema needs cross-file $ref (hand-rolled-validator discipline, schema/README.md).

language.description: The node-set language tag adopted by SEM-8 v0 (the observed encoding of examples 13-15), spec/node-set.md.

args.description: The forward's parameter list ('self' excluded), spec/node-set.md: plain input names (SEM-8 v0 envelope) OR exactly one record binding (the v0.4 inputs-bag envelope, D-041) -- the same two forms schema/node-set.schema.json pins in full.

oneOf.description: Plain form: the declared input names.

items.description: The record binding (v0.4, D-041): the module's own input record; full semantics in schema/node-set.schema.json $defs/record_binding.

oneOf.description: Record envelope (v0.4, D-041): exactly one record binding, the whole parameter list.

items.description: A statement carrying the `node` discriminator; full per-node validation is schema/node-set.schema.json.

body.description: The statement list, spec/node-set.md statement whitelist.

adapter_entry.description: A component-4 adapter pool entry: an adapter-ir preset, by reference to that contract (spec/manifest.md component 4). EITHER a builtin preset reference OR a full serialized preset object. The full form's internals (template, strategies block, codec bindings, literal_table) are owned by the adapter-ir contract and deliberately left loose here -- schema/README.md.

adapter_preset_ref.description: A builtin preset reference. Builtin presets resolve internally in any conforming engine, in any language (adapter-ir contract: builtin needs no language tag; the D-023 declared-tier profile requires builtin presets only).

preset.description: The builtin preset name (adapter-ir contract: built-in presets chat, json, xml, each byte-reproducing the historical class adapters). BAML is NOT a preset (it is json + baml codec bindings) and full_text is not yet ratified into this reference vocabulary.

versions.description: The preset's own versions block: the adapter-ir contract version plus the vocabulary entries in force (spec/versions.md: serialized adapter presets carry their own block; adapter-ir contract section 4). Entry set owned by the adapter-ir contract; loose here.

adapter_full_preset.description: A full serialized adapter-ir preset object. Its internal shape (template, strategies, codecs, literal_table, config, transforms, parsers) is the adapter-ir contract's to pin -- this schema requires only its own versions block (spec/versions.md: a preset with no block is refused as malformed) and that it not masquerade as a builtin reference. Note: an authored-origin adapter class inside such an entry makes the artifact fail the declared-tier profile with PIR-E-PROFILE-002 (D-026), a profile_check concern, not a schema one.

versions.description: The preset's own versions block (spec/versions.md; adapter-ir contract section 4).

tool_entry.description: A component-6 tool pool entry, spec/manifest.md component 6: identity + return_schema + source + deps + language + placement. Also the shape of component-12 metric entries ('tool-shaped', spec/manifest.md component 12).

name.description: The tool's dispatch name (identity); conventionally equal to its pool key.

description.description: Human/model-facing description of the tool. Optional.

parameters.description: Named parameter schemas ({param: JSON Schema}), declared not discovered (PIR-003).

return_schema.description: The tool's return type as JSON Schema, spec/manifest.md component 6. For metric entries this is the score shape (metric(example, prediction) -> score, IR-program-spec section b component 12).

source.description: Artifact-relative path to the baked source at rung 0, spec/manifest.md component 6 + on-disk layout (sidecars never inline, PIR-004).

deps.description: Declared dependency names, spec/manifest.md component 6 + PIR-003.

language.description: REQUIRED declared language, PIR-012; a foreign-language rung 0 triggers the rung-walk (PIR-010, spec/placement.md).

authored_by.description: PIR-014 provenance for machine-written tool code. Under D-043, 'optimizer' defaults the leaf's binding-level isolation floor through the receiver's trust profile (spec/trust.md).

kind.description: Optional unified-leaf-substrate invocation discriminant (D-043; PIR-021): 'call' -- one request/response (the default when absent); 'session' -- a held stateful context, fork-scoped (lifetime = leaf span) at fork_ratchet and above.

grants.description: The closed static effect row (D-043; PIR-021): every capability this leaf may be handed, readable from the manifest without executing anything. Absent means no grants.

interpreter_runtime.description: The exact runtime implementation whose semantics are program identity (D-033).

identity.description: Runtime identity, e.g. cpython, pyodide, gnu-bash, node, duckdb, or a remote sandbox service.

version.description: Exact runtime version or immutable service revision.

interpreter_entry.description: A named component-7 interpreter identity profile plus receiver-controlled placement (D-029, D-033). New writers emit the structural branch and stamp versions.interpreter_profile=1.0. The fused kind branch is legacy-readable only.

interpreter_legacy_entry.description: Legacy v0.1 fused-kind profile. Readers retain it for existing artifacts; writers never emit it after D-033.

interpreter_structural_entry.description: The canonical open structural interpreter profile (D-033). Every behavior-bearing identity field is explicit; arbitrary interpreter classes do not extend this fixed envelope nominally.

language.description: Open language tag: python, bash, javascript, sql, r, or another declared language.

contract.description: Language-neutral execute(code, vars) interface and typed result/error contract.

namespace_policy.description: How names, builtins, tools, and persistent scope are exposed.

result_convention.description: How successful execution produces the typed result.

vars_marshaling.description: How input variables cross into the runtime.

packages.description: Ordered package identities visible to generated code.

resource_limits.description: Declared resource limits; empty means no limits are claimed.

isolation_floor.description: Least isolation this identity permits, drawn from the ordered vocabulary (D-042, spec/placement.md; PIR-015); placement may move outward, never inward.

kind_invocation.description: Optional unified-leaf-substrate invocation discriminant (D-043; PIR-021); interpreters default to 'session'. Named kind_invocation here because 'kind' is the legacy fused-profile discriminator.

grants.description: The closed static effect row (D-043; PIR-021). Absent means no grants.

weights_files.description: Named weight sidecar files, spec/manifest.md component 8a/8b row: safetensors + tying.json + rebuild config; on-disk layout puts them under weights/ (binary sidecars never inline, PIR-004).

tensors.description: Path to the safetensors tensor file, spec/manifest.md components table (8a/8b row).

rebuild_config.description: Path to the rebuild config, spec/manifest.md components table (8a/8b row).

tying.description: Path to tying.json -- tensor ties are declared data verified at load, PIR-003.

tokenizer.description: Optional path to the tokenizer directory/file.

device.description: Optional path to the device map declaration.

additionalProperties.description: Additional named sidecar files (e.g. shards), each an artifact-relative path.

weights_block.description: Nested baked weights on an LM entry, spec/manifest.md D-029 ruling 1 (one entry per LM: identity + placement + nested weights when baked). Executing rung-0 weights is out of 1.0 conformance scope, but this slot's FORMAT is structural and in scope (spec/SCOPE.md).

format.description: The only ratified weights format, spec/manifest.md components table + PIR-004 (no pickle, weights never base64-in-JSON).

frozen.description: The frozen tag of the base-plus-delta rule: each of base and delta carries its own frozen/weight-ref tag (spec/manifest.md shape rules).

weight_ref.description: The weight-ref tag of the base-plus-delta rule (spec/manifest.md shape rules).

lm_entry.description: A component-8 LM pool entry: ONE object per LM -- identity + placement + nested weights when baked (spec/manifest.md D-029 ruling 1; 8a/8b are conceptual rows, never manifest keys). `engine` appears ONLY on baked entries (D-029 ruling 3: remote engines are the server's fact, not program identity) -- enforced via dependentRequired. `served_aliases` is an optional evidence hint (D-029 ruling 4).

forward_contract.description: The typed LM forward contract this entry serves (lm15 identity), spec/manifest.md component 8a row; component 8a IS the lm15 contract (README.md, the stack).

class.description: The LM class identity. For declared/remote entries this block is ADVISORY: the entry is served through the engine's own lm15 client after weights_identity verification, recorded as a binding substitution (spec/placement.md D-023).

weights_identity.description: REQUIRED model identity (D-029 ruling 4: weights_identity is the required identity). Verified against the serving endpoint at verify (spec/linking.md step 6; PIR-E-VERIFY-002 on mismatch).

served_aliases.description: OPTIONAL evidence hint: names the endpoint may serve this identity under (D-029 ruling 4; example 09 is the aliases-absent fixture).

engine.description: The in-process execution engine (e.g. 'transformers', 'vllm-offline'). ONLY lawful on baked entries -- presence requires nested weights (D-029 ruling 3), enforced by dependentRequired below.

weights.description: Nested baked weights (the presence of this block is what 'baked' means), spec/manifest.md D-029 ruling 1.

config.description: Optional entry-level LM configuration (loose; per-predictor sampling config lives in component 3c).

placement.description: Where this LM is served, spec/placement.md; the declared-tier profile requires every LM entry at a receiver-bound endpoint rung (D-023).

env_block.description: One per-language environment block, spec/manifest.md component 9 + PIR-012/D-025: the artifact carries one env block per language present; PEP 723/uv is the Python instance (keys like pep723_entry, lock, python_version, system_deps). The neutral cross-language schema is 1.x-provisional (spec/SCOPE.md, D-025 candidate: rat's runtime.yaml shape), so contents are loose here.

credential.description: A declared credential, spec/manifest.md component 10 + PIR-005: the artifact declares {name, scope} ONLY; values are byte-absent and checked positively at load (verify: PIR-E-VERIFY-001 names name+scope).

name.description: The credential's name, referenced by placement.credential_ref (PIR-005).

scope.description: What the credential is for, in words a verifier can name back (PIR-005; spec/errors.md VERIFY-001).

evaluation_block.description: Component 12 in the train/dev object: the named metric pool plus the ordered devset it scores. The whole component is droppable in ship objects; when present, both slots are explicit and required (PIR-004: absent, null, and empty are distinct).

metrics.description: Named pool of tool-shaped metric entries. Empty means the train/dev object explicitly carries no metric.

devset.description: Ordered evaluation examples, encoded exactly like component-3b demos: flat field values plus required input_keys[]. Empty means an explicitly empty devset.

components.description: The component map, spec/manifest.md components table. All rows except 12_metric are required; empty pools are empty objects, never null (PIR-004: absent, null, and {} are different values -- and the pool rows are required objects).

1_module_tree.description: Component 1: the module tree; leaves bind {adapter, lm, delta} by name (spec/manifest.md component 1; PIR-009).

2_signature.description: Component 2: per-predictor signatures keyed by predictor path (spec/manifest.md component 2). Key-set agreement with 3a/3b/3c and the tree's Predict paths is a LINK concern (PIR-009), not schema-expressible.

additionalProperties.description: The resolved instruction text -- the single canonical home for instructions (spec/manifest.md component 3a; IR-program-spec section b).

3a_instructions.description: Component 3a: per-predictor instructions -- instructions live here ONLY (spec/manifest.md component 3a).

additionalProperties.description: The predictor's demo list; may be empty.

3b_demos.description: Component 3b: per-predictor demos, each carrying input_keys[] (spec/manifest.md component 3b).

additionalProperties.description: Resolved LM call config ({temperature, n, max_tokens, top_p, stop, ...}), spec/manifest.md component 3c; contents loose until the LMConfig vocabulary is ratified.

3c_predictor_config.description: Component 3c: per-predictor resolved config -- the state dump_state historically dropped (IR-program-spec section b).

4_adapter.description: Component 4: the adapter pool -- named adapter-ir preset entries, by reference to that contract (spec/manifest.md component 4; README.md, the stack).

5_forward.description: Component 5: per-module forwards keyed by module path, node-set JSON (spec/manifest.md component 5; spec/node-set.md).

6_tools.description: Component 6: the tool pool (spec/manifest.md component 6). Empty object when the program has no tools.

7_interpreter.description: Component 7: the interpreter pool -- NAMED entries like tools (D-029 ruling 2); interpreter leaves reference an entry by name, default 'main'. Empty object when unused; the examples' null / unnamed-singleton forms are pre-ratification and fail here.

8_lm.description: Component 8: the LM pool -- one object per LM (D-029 ruling 1). The pre-ratification 8a_lm/8b_weights split fails here by construction (those keys are not in this closed component set).

9_environment.description: Component 9: per-language env blocks keyed by language tag (PIR-012/D-025). The examples' flat single-language block is pre-ratification; the migrator wraps it under its language key.

10_credentials.description: Component 10: declared credential names, values byte-absent (PIR-005).

11_ambient_policy.description: Component 11: the flat ambient-policy block (spec/manifest.md component 11 -- 'annotated IOU in the source spec'); contents loose until ratified.

12_metric.description: Component 12: metrics plus devset; DROPPABLE in ship objects, hence the only optional component row (spec/manifest.md component 12).
